analysis.title: Siemens Healthineers AG (SHLG.DE): Q4 26 slightly ahead on underlying basis; midpoint of FY27e guidance implies LSD downside vs consensus
key_insights: Siemens Healthineers Q4 FY26 comparable sales grew +5.9% vs Vara consensus +5.5%. Revenue was €6,784m, +0.6% ahead of consensus, led by Imaging at +10% comparable growth.

Group adjusted EBIT was €1,077m, 2.8% below Vara consensus. Group adjusted EBIT margin was 15.9%, down 150bps y/y. Q4 margin was hit by one-offs (net -200bps in Imaging, +150bps in Diagnostics). GS estimates adjusted EBIT would have been modestly ahead of expectations excluding them.
Q4 FY26 adjusted EPS was €0.69, 3% ahead of Vara consensus of €0.67. Finance cost and tax were both slightly better than consensus.

FY27e guidance is +4-5% comparable sales growth vs Vara consensus of 5.5%. The range includes a ~0.7% headwind from the shift in focus away from Ultrasound. By division: +MSD in Imaging, +MSD-HSD in Precision Therapy, flat revenue in Diagnostics.

FY27e adjusted EPS guidance is €2.20-2.40 vs Vara consensus of €2.37. The midpoint implies ~3% downgrade to consensus. Guidance assumes a modest step-up in finance cost, the Ultrasound exit headwind and more prudent China and inflation assumptions.
Management started the carve-out of Diagnostics, targeting a standalone unit by mid 2028. The mid-term ambition of mid-teens Diagnostics margin was reiterated.

Imaging Q4 sales were €3,729m, 3% above consensus. PCCT and radiopharmaceuticals kept growing at a high rate and MR was very strong. Adjusted EBIT margin was 21.9% (-60bps vs consensus, -70bps y/y). Underlying margin ex one-offs was 23.9%, +150bps vs consensus.

Precision Therapy Q4 comparable growth was +4.8% vs 8.1% consensus. Sales were €1,968m, 5% below consensus. Growth was softer on preparation to focus the Ultrasound portfolio. Varian grew strongly, APAC (including China) grew sharply, Americas grew moderately and EMEA declined slightly. Adjusted EBIT margin was 13.8% (-180bps vs consensus, -330bps y/y) on FX and inflation headwinds and a strong prior-year comparison (17.1% in Q4 25).

Diagnostics Q4 comparable sales fell -4.2% vs -5.5% consensus. Sales were €1,067m, 2% above consensus. China market rebasing and legacy platform declines continued, but absolute revenue stabilised sequentially. Adjusted EBIT margin was 5.4% (+210bps vs consensus, -210bps y/y), including ~150bps of one-off benefit from tariff refunds and pension plans. Underlying margin was 3.9% (+60bps vs consensus, -360bps y/y).
GS rates the stock Neutral with a 12-month price target of €43 vs a €44.85 price (4.1% downside). The stock trades on 15.7x 12-month forward P/E.

market_movers.rationale: Neutral on Siemens Healthineers with a €43 target, 4.1% below the €44.85 price. FY27e EPS guidance midpoint implies ~3% downgrade to consensus. Target blends DCF (€44.8) and 16x P/E (€41.8) at 50% each.

earnings_insights: Q4 FY26 (reported 5 Nov 2026) adjusted EPS €0.69 vs Vara consensus €0.67 (+3.0%) and GSe €0.68 (+0.9%). FY26 adjusted EPS was €2.42 vs consensus €2.39.
Q4 FY26 revenue €6,784m reported vs Vara consensus €6,744m (+0.6%) and GSe €6,787m. Comparable sales growth was +5.9% vs consensus +5.5%.
Q4 FY26 group adjusted EBIT was €1,077m reported vs Vara consensus €1,108m (-2.8%) and GSe €1,133m (-4.9%). Adjusted EBIT margin was 15.9% vs consensus 16.4%.
FY27e guidance: comparable sales growth +4-5% vs Vara consensus 5.5%, adjusted EPS €2.20-2.40 vs Vara consensus €2.37. The midpoint (€2.30) is ~3% below consensus.
GS FY27e EPS estimate is €2.37 and FY28e is €2.61, vs FY26 of €2.42. GS FY27e revenue is €25,264.6m.
risk_factors: Upside risks: material stimulus for hospital capex in China, faster Diagnostics transformation, upside on Varian synergies and margin, stronger pricing tailwinds.
Downside risks: material slowdown in order growth, supply chain constraints, sustained adverse impact from the China anti-corruption campaign, market share losses.
